candidate_relations.reason: Congenital granular cell tumor is an accepted name for the neonatal gingival lesion congenital granular cell epulis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Synonym for congenital granular cell epulis.

candidate_relations.reason: Myofibroma is not congenital granular cell epulis despite potentially presenting as an infantile oral mass.
Gingival cysts of the newborn are typically small keratin-filled papules, not large pedunculated congenital epulides.
Lymphangioma is a vascular-lymphatic lesion and not congenital granular cell epulis.
Hemangioma does not represent the referenced congenital granular cell gingival tumor.
A neonatal gingival cyst is not synonymous with congenital granular cell epulis and generally has a different small cystic presentation.
Langerhans cell histiocytosis is not the referenced congenital gingival granular cell lesion.
Melanotic neuroectodermal tumor of infancy is a different neoplasm, commonly pigmented and intraosseous rather than a congenital pedunculated epulis.
Teratoma is not congenital granular cell epulis, although an oral teratoma can also cause neonatal feeding or airway problems.
Congenital epulis conventionally denotes congenital granular cell epulis in a newborn with pedunculated alveolar-ridge masses.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Accepted abbreviated synonym for congenital granular cell epulis.
